experiment.name: Severity literature extraction: markers and host or parasite factors tested against severity (117 articles, schema v2)
experiment.description: Which markers and host or parasite factors have canine babesiosis studies tested against severity or outcome, under which definitions and in how many independent cohorts? Descriptive groundwork for SV-03 and SV-02a; no hypothesis is tested.

parameters.scope: shortlist tier A/B, source_format not abstract

experiment.summary: 117 of 117 full-text tier A/B articles extracted under schema v2: 740 marker-by-severity rows from 49 articles in 42 independent units (78 severity definitions, 131 canonical markers, 75 in 2 or more units). Blind 20% second extraction: significance agreement 0.99, direction agreement 0.981 on 104 matched pairs. Descriptive; no tests.

results.title: Records by cohort and independent unit
Agreement with the blind second extraction and the pilot

sections.heading: Question
paragraphs: Which laboratory markers and host or parasite factors have published canine babesiosis studies tested against severity or outcome, under which definitions, in which species and in how many independent cohorts? SV-G2 is the groundwork for SV-03 (evidence matrix) and SV-02a (parasite load by outcome); it has no hypothesis test.

sections.heading: What was done
paragraphs: Every shortlist article with tier A or B and a full text (117 articles, 99 independent units) was extracted by sub-agents in batches of about 10 under schema v2, which adds definition components, euthanasia, definition source, follow-up horizon, setting, sample timing, per-group values with summary type, the parasite load method, and a list of what could not be extracted. The ten pilot articles were re-extracted first as a calibration batch. Every quote was checked against the article text by the checker; the owner checked a sample of each batch by hand. A blind second extraction of a random 20% sample (24 articles, seed 20261112) measured agreement.
Counts are independent units: articles that share a cohort in /core/cohorts.json count once. Rows are not evidence.

sections.heading: Result
paragraphs: 740 rows (260 significant, 254 not significant, 192 not tested) from 49 articles; 68 articles reported nothing against severity. Markers reported in the most independent units: Haematocrit/PCV (21), Creatinine (16), Urea (16), Platelet count (15), White blood cell count (15), Bilirubin (14).
Quotes: 740 exact and 0 near of 740 rows. Second extraction: coverage 0.954 of the first extraction's marker-by-outcome keys, significance agreement 0.99 (kappa 0.985), direction agreement 0.981.

sections.heading: What this does not show
paragraphs: This is a description of what was reported, not a synthesis: direction counts are not effect sizes, and markers reported only when significant (selective reporting) inflate the 'higher' and 'lower' columns. Species is aliased with source, setting and definition: do not compare species from these counts. Categories and cohort links come from NLP and agent extraction with one owner check, not a full human review. The 34 abstract-only tier B articles are not included. Mortality definitions usually count euthanasia as death.
